# MDL102 · `whitespace-only-line`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A line contains only spaces or tabs.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | loading |
| Default severity | error |
| Fix | safe |
| Flags | unsuppressible |
| Design references | P0, cases 01-04 |
| Proven on real mydumper by | [`mdl102-whitespace-line-drops-masking`](../../e2e/scenarios/mdl102-whitespace-line-drops-masking.txtar) |

## Why

Before handing the file to GLib, mydumper appends `= 1` to every line without `=`, so that valueless flags such as `routines` get a value. A line of spaces becomes `  = 1`: a key/value pair with an empty key. GLib rejects it, and mydumper silently ignores the whole file.

The same line is harmless as the very last line of a file without a final newline, because the rewrite only happens before a `\n`. That is a trap: the file passes every test on its own and breaks as soon as a script appends a block to it.

## Example

❌ Before:

```text
[mydumper]
threads=4
··
routines
```

(`\r`, `\t` and `\xHH` stand for the bytes they name, `·` for a trailing space)

```text
3:1-3:3 error MDL102[whitespace-only-line] line contains only whitespace: mydumper's pre-processor turns it into `  = 1`, a key/value pair with an empty key (GLib: Key file contains line “  = 1” which is not a key-value pair, group, or comment)
  = mydumper ignores this entire file: it only logs a WARNING ("Failed to load config file") and runs with its defaults, exit code 0.
  fix (safe): Remove the whitespace
```

✅ After `mydumper-lint check --fix`:

```ini
[mydumper]
threads=4

routines
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL102: warning   # or error, info, off
```

Its diagnostics mean mydumper ignores the whole file: they cannot be suppressed by comments, only by the configuration or `--ignore`.
